name: Helpless Ladybug 43
author: Rodrypaladin
description: Gradient dark rounded purple button that glows on hover.
howItWorks:
On hover, border-radius becomes 1.5em, border-radius becomes 1.3em, box-shadow becomes -15px -10px 30px -5px #e100ff,
    15px -10px 30px -5px #ff00d4,
    15px 10px 30px -5px #ffae00,
    -15px 10px 30px -5px #ffe601.
